subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should OpenClaw keep pursuing this PR's exit-0 authenticated probe design, or close/replace it with the shipped exit-78 systemd lock-recovery direction?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 already solve the central systemd restart-loop with a different service-manager contract, while this branch changes auth/startup semantics and has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Confirm exit-78 supersession
options.body: Close or leave this PR idle only after confirming the shipped systemd exit-78 behavior is the intended product direction and any remaining non-systemd probe gap belongs in a fresh narrow issue or PR.

options.title: Sponsor a rebased probe repair
options.body: Ask for a rebase that keeps only a remaining proven gap, preserves the systemd exit-78 path, fixes trusted-proxy source validation and IPv6 URLs, removes unrelated churn, and adds real supervisor proof.

options.title: Accept exit-0 probe semantics
options.body: Explicitly choose the exit-0 healthy-probe behavior despite the compatibility, auth-boundary, and availability tradeoffs, then require upgrade and real-behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Confirm exit-78 supersession
recommendation.body: Close or leave this PR idle only after confirming the shipped systemd exit-78 behavior is the intended product direction and any remaining non-systemd probe gap belongs in a fresh narrow issue or PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current-main shipped exit-78 fix in the related issue discussion.
